Opposite Parties  Mr. Sabita Ranjan Pattanaik,
 Additional Government Advocate  CORAM:
JUSTICE K.R. MOHAPATRA  JUSTICE SAVITRI RATHO  ORDER Order No. 02.12.2025  01. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. This writ application has been filed with a prayer to release and disburse the share of compensation in the award for land acquisition in favour of the Petitioner as per the final decree in Title Suit No. 71/20 of 1986/1989.

3. Mr. Guru, learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the Plot No. 1189 in Khata No. 54 to an extent of Ac 0.300 dec. of Mouza Sarala (Sambalpur Town, Unit No.16), in the district of Sambalpur (for brevity, "the case land") was acquired for Sambalpur, Talcher doubling of railway line.

Prior to acquisition proceeding, the case land fell to the share of the Petitioner in a final decree proceeding of Title Suit No. 16/20 of 1986/1989 of the Court of the learned Civil Judge, Senior Division,
Sambalpur.

entities.text:
Court of the learned Civil Judge, Senior Division,
Sambalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: But, the award under the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency of Land Acquisition (Rehabilitation and Resettlement) Act, 2013 (for brevity, "the Act") was passed in respect of all the co-sharers.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency of Land Acquisition (Rehabilitation and Resettlement) Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Hence, the Petitioner made an application before the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Talcher, Sambalpur on 23rd October, 2025 to release his share in the compensation.
The said application has not yet been disposed of.

4. In course of hearing, Mr. Guru, learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that interest of justice will be best served, if the Petitioner files an application before the Collector, Sambalpur under Section 64 of the Act to refer the matter to the Authority for apportionment of his share in the compensation.

5. Mr. Pattanaik, learned Additional Government Advocate submits that he has no instruction in the matter but if the Petitioner wants to file an application under Section 64 of the Act, the same may be considered in accordance with law.

sentences.text:
Taking note of the submission made by learned counsel for the Parties, this Court disposes of the writ petition with a direction that in the event the Petitioner files an application under Section 64 of the Act before the Collector, Sambalpur within a period of two weeks hence, the same shall be considered in accordance with law giving opportunity of hearing to the Petitioner.
Urgent certified copy of the order shall be granted on proper application.

(K.R. Mohapatra)
 Judge  (Savitri Ratho)
 Subhalaxmi Judge Signed by: SUBHALAXMI PRIYADARSHANI

opennyai_summary.facts:
Prior to acquisition proceeding, the case land fell to the share of the Petitioner in a final decree proceeding of Title Suit No. 16/20 of 1986/1989 of the Court of the learned Civil Judge, Senior Division,
Sambalpur.
But, the award under the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency of Land Acquisition (Rehabilitation and Resettlement) Act, 2013 (for brevity, "the Act") was passed in respect of all the co-sharers.
Hence, the Petitioner made an application before the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Talcher, Sambalpur on 23rd October, 2025 to release his share in the compensation.
The said application has not yet been disposed of.

Urgent certified copy of the order shall be granted on proper application.
